## 2026-10-20 机型收藏 / 新增实机参考

- **nokia3310**: `nokia3310-archive-reference.jpg` — Rainer Knäpper; retouch Multicherry; 2009-01-14; [Free Art License](https://artlibre.org/licence/lal/en/); [原图](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia_3310_Blue_R7309170_(retouch).jpg). Original reference retained. Cropped/contour-mapped and resized for interactive Blender model; derived GLB/photo material shared under the same source license.
- **razr**: `razr-archive-reference.png` — Raimond Spekking; 2017-11-16; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); [原图](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Motorola_Razr_V3_montage_closed_open.png). Original reference retained. Cropped/contour-mapped and resized for interactive Blender model; derived GLB/photo material shared under the same source license.
- **n95**: `n95-archive-reference.jpg` — Asim18; 2008-12-14; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); [原图](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia_N95_Front_1.jpg). Original reference retained. Cropped/contour-mapped and resized for interactive Blender model; derived GLB/photo material shared under the same source license.
- **k750**: `k750-archive-reference.jpg` — Jyi1693; 2007-04-21; [CC BY 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/); [原图](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sony_K750i_front.JPG). No edits to reference file; used for visual comparison, not historical screenshot.

3310/V3/N95 的对应 `models/*-collection.glb` 含上述照片的裁切映射，相关改编资产按相同来源许可证发布。K750照片仅在资料夹对照，不进入机身贴图。2017年V3组合图与2009年3310照片不冒充机型上市当年拍摄。新增机身为本项目Blender重建，未调用新Hyper3D付费生成，也不是原厂CAD或完整系统仿真。

### 2026-10-21 articulated handset correction
- V3: rechecked the licensed Raimond Spekking CC BY-SA 4.0 closed/open montage (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Motorola_Razr_V3_montage_closed_open.png). Repositioned reconstruction hinge/inner material and input planes to prevent floating layers; the photographed outer display is static, not a live factory screen. No new source photo added.
- N97: Nokia's 2008 product description documents the tilt display above the keyboard: https://blogs.windows.com/devices/2008/12/02/nokia-n97-marks-evolutionary-milestone-for-nseries-and-mobilekind-2/ . Nokia data sheet (2008, hosted at https://files.dinside.no/0/2843200.pdf) specifies 640×360, 16:9. Reconstructed support geometry and tilt are an approximation, not factory CAD; display ratio now matches the data sheet.
- N95 display geometry now uses the original 240×320 3:4 raster ratio, preserving the existing independently licensed reference texture.

### K750 front reconstruction, 2026-10-21
The existing Jyi1693 CC BY 2.5 front photograph (`k750-archive-reference.jpg`, original source above) was used to compare the black fascia, dark keypad deck, chrome joystick and split digit legends. Geometry is manually reconstructed, not a camera projection or factory CAD. The side music button is referenced against Sony Ericsson K750i user guide (February 2005), manufacturer-hosted PDF: https://www-support-downloads.sonymobile.com/k750/userguide_EN_K750.pdf . Website playback is a local simulation, not the original headset-dependent firmware behavior.

### Nokia 7610 live front, 2026-10-21
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nokia_7610.png ; photograph 2007-06-18 by Kaliy~commonswiki, cutout attributed by Commons to AnVuong1222004 (11). Original retained as `nokia7610-archive-reference.png`.
- CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Our changes: crop/contour mapping and resizing onto independent Blender body; replacement of pictured display with a live local webpage; separate photo-calibrated key hit geometry. The derived GLB/photo material is offered under CC BY-SA 4.0. No original firmware is included. Photo date is not the phone launch date.

### Original iPhone geometry correction, 2026-10-21
Primary reference: Apple archived technical specifications https://support.apple.com/en-us/112445 (115×61×11.6 mm, 3.5-inch display, 480×320 raster). Reconstruction uses width scale 2.1/61; screen width/height derive from the stated diagonal and 2:3 portrait ratio. Port/trim details and desktop are interpretive geometry/UI, not factory CAD, Apple images or an iOS distribution. Side controls operate the website audio/video only.
